expo.name: Partner — Host & Driver
expo.description: Partner Console for Himalayan Homestay Hosts and Cab Drivers across Darjeeling, Kurseong, Kalimpong and Sikkim.

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: This app uses your location to discover nearby drivers and coordinate passenger pickups accurately in mountain regions.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This app needs access to your photos to upload homestay room and property images.
